content.title: Italian Citizenship Assistance | Italian Citizenship Services
content.text: YOUR GATEWAY TO ITALIAN CITIZENSHIP AND VISAS At Italian Citizenship Assistance (ICA), our mission is to help you navigate the path to Italian citizenship and the visas that allow you to live, work, and study in Italy and across the European Union. Whether your goal is to become an Italian citizen or to obtain the right visa, we guide you every step of the way, helping you access the benefits of life in Italy and the EU, including high-quality healthcare, affordable education, and unrestricted travel. With offices in Rovigo (Italy), Los Angeles, Dallas, New York City, and the Republic of San Marino, ICA is the ideal partner for individuals seeking Italian citizenship by descent (Jure Sanguinis), marriage (Jure Matrimonii), or residency, as well as those exploring visa options to live and work in Italy. Our team includes dual citizenship experts, attorneys, genealogists, and translators, all specialized in Italian citizenship and immigration law. In collaboration with our law firm in Rovigo and associates in New York City and Los Angeles, we provide comprehensive services at competitive rates to help you successfully obtain dual citizenship, an Italian passport, or the appropriate visa. From document procurement to translations and legal filings, we manage all the steps of the citizenship or visa process, including: Obtaining Italian vital records for your ancestors or family members Procuring U.S. or foreign documents and official translations into Italian Guiding you through the full application or petition process in Italy or abroad Whether you need a full-service package or a tailored solution based on your unique situation, ICA makes it simple to achieve your goals. *Our services are available to citizens of the U.S., U.K., Australia, and other countries, whether you are living at home or abroad, including within the EU.
